decision.selected_method: independent full-horizon replay of the exact saved control schedule

decision.hypothesis: An independent full 0-to-0.6 s replay of the exact saved schedule will resolve whether the candidate satisfies the frozen task under replay, because the existing sampled native calculation lies extremely close to the holding-position and holding-speed boundaries but does not constitute independent acceptance.
decision.interpretation: Replay the unchanged candidate with the exact saved schedule rather than inferring success or infeasibility from the finite local search. A passing replay would establish only the registered replay-scope result for this candidate and schedule; a failing replay would localize the observed failure under the replay measurements but would not prove that other legal controls or structures are infeasible.
decision.expected_observation: The fresh replay returns complete 0-to-0.6 s measurements and a frozen-task verdict for the exact schedule; if the near-boundary native prediction transfers, the limiting observation will occur near the holding window and will be close to the 0.01 m position-error or 0.03 m/s speed boundary.
decision.weakening_observation: A replay trajectory that differs materially from the saved native prediction, or a clear pass or failure with substantial margin away from both reported boundaries, would weaken the hypothesis that the near-boundary sampled native behavior transfers to independent replay.
decision.fixed_conditions: Keep the candidate structure, frozen task, standardized initial state, 0.6 s horizon, 0.02 s control period, tendon order, 0-to-8 N bounds, and every value in the saved control schedule unchanged; perform one fresh independent full-horizon replay with no control re-optimization or design modification.
decision.stopping_condition: Stop after one fresh replay completes with a valid full-horizon record and frozen-task verdict, or after a recorded execution failure makes that verdict unavailable; do not add repetitions because repeatability is outside the frozen confirmation scope.
